findings.title: [P2] Bind downstream artifact reads to the verified tree
findings.spec_quote: 门禁使用可信实际case与不可变来源；缺文件/篡改…都要失败
findings.trigger: Replace a verified case directory, ancestor or artifact after inventory verification, then allow pidiff or a returned Bundle business-proof consumer to reopen its ordinary path.
findings.impact: The consumer can follow a symlink or consume same-case proof bytes not covered by the verified artifact digest.
findings.requested_change: Use rooted, bounded, expected-hash reads for every consumed artifact and verify the original bundle identity; add failure-first public replacement and same-semantics tamper coverage.
findings.relevance: Incomplete replacement containment in the touched consumer boundary.
